name: Write File
description: Write a text file into the sandbox (e.g. data, a module or a page for run-code to use or publish), or delete a file or folder there. Paths are sandbox paths: /work/... (this chat's scratch), /project/... (the workspace's, kept) or /shared/... (every workspace's, kept); a relative path is under /work. Deleting /work, /project or /shared empties it. Deleting works even when the sandbox is over its size limit.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Save these figures as a CSV we can use later

path.description: The file's path in the sandbox, e.g. '/project/data/in.csv'.

content.description: The whole file (at most 1 MB). Leave out when deleting.

delete.description: Set true to delete the file or folder at path instead of writing it.
